**November Highlights!**

In the *Torkwase x Theatre* workshop, theatre educators from the Vorarlberger Landestheater will show children how to explore Torkwase Dyson’s exhibition through playful acting and performance-based activities. The new professional development format *Kunstbox* offers teachers inspiring ideas for everyday classroom practice. Inclusive guided tours for Deaf visitors, and people living with dementia ensure an accessible programme throughout November.

## **Torkwase Dyson**

KUB 2026.03  
**Torkwase Dyson**  
17 | 10 | 2026 – 24 | 01 | 2027

Dyson’s works are both monumental and fragile, modular and interconnected. The experience always remains physically palpable. Her work dispenses with fixed structures and thrives on improvisation, transience, and change.

### The Porsche Takes a Break

In 2006, as part of his exhibition at Kunsthaus Bregenz, Vorarlberg artist Gottfried Bechtold lined up eleven concrete Porsche sculptures from his ensemble *Elf Elf* on Karl-Tizian-Platz. Now, due to the upcoming renovation works at the Vorarlberger Landestheater, the concrete Porsche will temporarily leave its usual location. Throughout the construction period, which is expected to continue until summer 2027, access to Kunsthaus Bregenz will remain unaffected.

### New KUB Editions by KOO JEONG A and Cyprien Gaillard

Originally presented in the KUB exhibition *LAND OF OUSSS [ GRAVITTA ]*, KOO JEONG A’s edition features two photographs of the Alps taken from an airplane and is available as a set. Cyprien Gaillard’s *O (The Empty Hollow)* combines flute mouthpieces with zero-euro banknotes. Both editions are available now.

[Read more](/en/editions)

### In the Shop: Take Home a Memory of Florentina Holzinger’s Performance

Festival cups in a practical 400 ml size and unique bags made from ripstop parachute silk. These collectible tote bags are feather-light while offering exceptional durability.

The limited editions are available exclusively at the KUB ticket desk!

[/en/publications](/en/publications)

### KOO JEONG A – LAND OF OUSSS [ GRAVITTA ]

KOO JEONG A’s works create a delicate balance between the visible and the invisible, subtly challenging our perception of space and time. Exhibition views, reproduced using only silver and black, enter into dialogue with poetic text fragments by the Italian author Federico Nicolao. Together, they create a space in which the works presented in Bregenz can fully unfold their impact.

[Read more](/en/publications)

### Podcast "Cloud Castle" – Biennale Special!

In the fourth episode—a special edition of the *Cloud Castle* podcast—the directors of Bündner Kunstmuseum Chur, Kunsthaus Bregenz, Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein, and Kunstmuseum St.Gallen report directly from Venice on Venice, sharing unfiltered first impressions from the opening days of the 61st Biennale di Venezia.

[Read more](http://www.cloudcastle.art)

### The “House” Moves to Switzerland

In late 2025 Kunsthaus Bregenz opened an international call for proposals presenting concepts for the reuse of the “House” from the previous exhibition ███████. The parasitic object was on view at KUB until January 18, 2026, and is to continue to be used as an artist's residence and exhibition space at City SALTS on the outskirts of Basel. A jury and ███████ selected the project out of some fifty submissions.

[Read more](/en/news/call-for-proposals-artistic-reuse-of-the-house-on-view-at-the-current-exhibition)

Kunsthaus Bregenz reaches another goal in terms of sustainability: The Institution is now officially part of the Austrian Ecolabel.
